title: Scalable and unsupervised discovery from raw sequencing reads using SPLASH2
concrete_content: SPLASH2 uses scalable k-mer counting to discover regulated sequence variation and demonstrated unannotated cancer splicing and circular RNA in CCLE bulk RNA-seq.
decision_changed: Separate annotation-free discovery from routine alignment and gene quantification.
constraints: It is not an end-to-end QC or quantification pipeline; bulk findings still need locus-level and orthogonal validation.
skill_action: Record the discovery route and validate novel sequence events before biological interpretation.
writing_requirement: Methods must distinguish annotation-free discovery from annotated quantification; Results and legends must label novel events and their supporting evidence.

title: Comprehensive assessment of transcriptome assembly quality using CATS
concrete_content: CATS jointly evaluates reference-free and reference-based transcriptome assembly quality across 1056 simulated and public transcriptomes.
decision_changed: Require assembly completeness and error diagnostics before interpreting reconstructed transcripts.
constraints: Assembly QC is relevant when transcript reconstruction is central and should not force de novo assembly into ordinary gene-count studies.
skill_action: Create an assembly-QC gate and route conventional reference-based gene analysis separately.
writing_requirement: Methods must state reference and assembly evaluation; Results must report completeness/error dimensions rather than one summary score.

title: A systematic benchmark of Nanopore long-read RNA sequencing for transcript-level analysis in human cell lines
concrete_content: The study compares Nanopore protocols with PacBio and short-read approaches using controlled human cell-line data and spike-ins for isoform discovery and quantification.
decision_changed: Choose long-read chemistry and depth according to transcript-level estimand instead of assuming platform superiority.
constraints: Cell-line and tested-chemistry performance may not transfer to FFPE, low-input clinical tissue, or later chemistries.
skill_action: Demand platform-specific QC, spike-in or orthogonal checks, and a short-read/gene-level comparator when relevant.
writing_requirement: Report chemistry, read processing, depth, truth material and task-specific error; discuss platform transfer limits.

title: SNP calling, haplotype phasing and allele-specific analysis with long RNA-seq reads
concrete_content: longcallR jointly calls SNPs, phases haplotypes and estimates allele-specific expression or splicing; in 202 human samples it found many events involving unannotated junctions.
decision_changed: Add allele/haplotype as a distinct feature layer when long reads and coverage support it.
constraints: Long-read coverage, reference mapping bias, RNA editing and phasing error can mimic allele imbalance; imbalance is not automatically a cis mechanism.
skill_action: Audit informative reads, phasing and reference bias and require independent allele or functional validation for key claims.
writing_requirement: Methods and legends must state phasing/support rules; Discussion must separate allele-specific association from cis-regulatory causality.

modality: long-read RNA-seq at single-cell pseudobulk and bulk resolution
title: Accurate long-read transcript discovery and quantification at single-cell, pseudo-bulk and bulk resolution with Isosceles
concrete_content: Isosceles evaluates Nanopore isoform discovery and quantification at single-cell, aggregated pseudobulk and true bulk resolution.
decision_changed: Keep resolution, transcript discovery and patient-level replication as separate contracts.
constraints: Pseudobulk is an aggregation of measured cells and is not a set of independent patients; the tool does not replace gene-level counting.
skill_action: Label the resolution of every matrix and route patient-level inference through independent biological samples.
writing_requirement: Methods and figures must distinguish single-cell, pseudobulk and true bulk inputs; Results must not inflate n with aggregates.

title: edgeR v4: powerful differential analysis of sequencing data with expanded functionality and improved support for small counts and larger datasets
concrete_content: edgeR v4 expands quasi-likelihood differential analysis for small or fractional counts, complex designs, fold-change thresholds and exon or transcript usage.
decision_changed: Use count-compatible inference with an explicit estimable design, effect sizes and multiplicity rather than generic normalized-expression testing.
constraints: TPM or FPKM is not automatically valid input for a count likelihood; statistical significance does not replace effect and diagnostic review.
skill_action: Audit count provenance, design rank, filtering, normalization, influence, contrasts, CI and FDR.
writing_requirement: Methods must state formula, contrast, filter, normalization, robust policy and FDR family; Results must report effects and uncertainty.

theme: reference genome choice and mapping bias
title: Benchmarking genome choice in functional genomics analyses
concrete_content: The study compares hg38, CHM13, draft pangenome and personal phased assemblies for RNA-seq and other functional assays in five fully assembled LCL donors.
decision_changed: Make reference representation and annotation a documented analysis choice and sensitivity-test biologically important reference-sensitive loci.
constraints: Overall genome-choice effects were usually modest and the benchmark used five LCL donors; it does not mandate personal assemblies for all studies.
skill_action: Record genome/annotation and rerun key reference-sensitive findings when their interpretation depends on mapping.
writing_requirement: Methods must name the representation; Results and Discussion must quantify and bound reference sensitivity.

title: Characterising processing conditions that artifactually bias human brain tissue transcriptomes
concrete_content: Immediate, approximately 6-hour and approximately 36-hour human brain processing conditions reveal structured artifact genes and a time-temperature response signature.
decision_changed: Treat post-mortem interval, time and temperature as potential causes of expression programs before DE, pathways or subtyping.
constraints: The evidence is adult brain/autopsy-specific; an artifact score flags risk but cannot recover the original transcriptome or act as universal batch correction.
skill_action: Plot pre-analytic variables by group, restrict or adjust with sensitivity analysis, and stop when processing is fully confounded with contrast.
writing_requirement: Report processing distributions, artifact sensitivity and residual confounding in Methods, Results, legends and Discussion.

theme: targeted assay utility and FFPE QC
title: Clinical utility of targeted RNA sequencing in cancer molecular diagnostics
concrete_content: A single targeted assay was applied prospectively to 2310 neoplasms, with a 4.8% failure rate despite mostly FFPE material and documented diagnostic and treatment consequences.
decision_changed: For clinical RNA assays report failure, diagnostic reclassification and actionability, not only analytical detections.
constraints: A specialized targeted diagnostic assay is not whole-transcriptome discovery and cannot be generalized to prognosis or all laboratories.
skill_action: Define panel universe, specimen quality, failure accounting and intended clinical use; bound non-targeted genes as unmeasured.
writing_requirement: Methods and Results must report panel, failures and clinical consequence; Discussion must limit transfer beyond the tested service.

title: Machine learning-optimized targeted detection of alternative splicing
concrete_content: LSV-seq uses machine-learning-designed primers to enrich junction-spanning reads and sensitively quantify preselected splicing events at lower sequencing depth.
decision_changed: Use targeted measurement when biologically important splice events are undercovered by ordinary RNA-seq, while preserving the measured-universe boundary.
constraints: Primer design and preselection limit unbiased transcriptome-wide discovery and counts are not directly interchangeable with standard RNA-seq.
skill_action: Require event definition, primer/coverage QC and orthogonal confirmation; do not infer global absence from panel non-detection.
writing_requirement: Methods and legends must describe targeted events and coverage; Discussion must state ascertainment limits.

title: Shiba: a versatile computational method for systematic identification of differential RNA splicing across platforms
concrete_content: Shiba integrates assembly, event identification, junction counting and differential splicing, including unannotated events and junction-read imbalance, in a containerized workflow.
decision_changed: Route splicing through event-level counts, coverage and null hypotheses rather than infer it from gene DE.
constraints: Demonstrated technical operation at n=1 does not replace biological replication; low coverage and event multiplicity remain limiting.
skill_action: Add minimum event support, biological-replicate modeling, complete FDR results and targeted validation of key events.
writing_requirement: Report event definition, support, effect, FDR and validation; legends must show coordinates and informative-read denominator.

title: Optimized murine sample sizes for RNA sequencing studies revealed from large scale comparative analysis
concrete_content: Two mouse experiments with 30 biological replicates per group quantify false positives, missed effects and stability under repeated smaller subsamples.
decision_changed: Base power on independent biological n, variance and meaningful effect; a larger fold-change threshold cannot rescue insufficient replication.
constraints: The observed n=6–7 behavior is mouse-, tissue-, effect- and threshold-specific and is not a universal minimum.
skill_action: Require a design-specific power or precision rationale and downgrade null/absence claims when CIs are wide.
writing_requirement: Methods must justify n and unit; Results must report effect CIs and stability; Discussion must avoid universal sample-size rules.

title: A metrological foundation for absolute transcriptomics using International System of Units-anchored calibrators
concrete_content: One hundred SI-traceable biomimetic calibrators characterize systematic and sequence-dependent bias and connect sequencing readout to absolute transcript quantity.
decision_changed: Distinguish relative compositional abundance from absolute molecules and permit absolute wording only with processing-stage calibration.
constraints: Calibrators must accompany samples through processing and cannot retrospectively fix public historical data; transfer and dynamic range require validation.
skill_action: Record calibrator timing and traceability or replace absolute claims with relative abundance.
writing_requirement: Methods must specify calibration chain; Results must report uncertainty/bias; legends and Discussion must label relative versus absolute scales.

title: Transcriptome size matters for single-cell RNA-seq normalization and bulk deconvolution
concrete_content: The study shows that total mRNA differences among cell types, gene length and reference variance systematically bias bulk deconvolution, especially for rare cells.
decision_changed: Audit whether the target is RNA contribution or cell fraction and test transcriptome-size correction before interpreting composition.
constraints: Correction relies on the reference and remains an estimate; it does not convert deconvolution into FACS or histology truth.
skill_action: Report target quantity, reference and correction; validate key fractions and rare states orthogonally.
writing_requirement: Use “estimated fraction/contribution” and report transcriptome-size sensitivity in Methods, Results and legends.

title: Alleviating batch effects in cell type deconvolution with SCCAF-D
concrete_content: SCCAF-D directly studies cross-source batch effects between bulk mixtures and single-cell references and shows why same-source pseudobulk benchmarks can overestimate performance.
decision_changed: Make bulk-reference distribution shift a gate and evaluate correction using independent or orthogonal truth.
constraints: Correction can remove genuine disease variation; improved mixing or correlation alone is not proof of biological validity.
skill_action: Compare uncorrected and corrected results against truth and preserve the biological contrast in the adjustment.
writing_requirement: Methods must state reference/batch strategy; Results must show sensitivity; Discussion must not claim complete batch removal.

title: Community assessment of methods to deconvolve cellular composition from bulk gene expression
concrete_content: Six published and 22 community methods were evaluated with held-out in-vitro and in-silico mixtures; broad cell types were more recoverable than several functional T-cell states.
decision_changed: Select deconvolution according to target cell/state and truth scenario rather than one global leaderboard.
constraints: Controlled mixtures do not reproduce all tumor ecology; fine functional states remain difficult and an author correction should be consulted.
skill_action: Collapse unsupported states, report method/reference sensitivity and obtain independent tissue truth.
writing_requirement: Results and legends must label estimates and state truth/reference; Discussion must bound fine-state claims.

modality: bulk RNA-seq with FACS or single-cell reference
title: An interpretable and adaptive autoencoder for efficient tissue deconvolution
concrete_content: Sweetwater models pseudobulk-to-real distribution shift, supports multiple reference classes and provides a small FACS-mixed PBMC gold-standard dataset with RNA-quantity information.
decision_changed: Audit reference choice, real-versus-simulated shift and interpretability before accepting deep deconvolution output.
constraints: The gold standard is small and largely same-donor; adaptation does not guarantee tissue, platform or disease transport and learned weights are not mechanism.
skill_action: Use matched truth where possible and test across references, gene sets and held-out real bulk samples.
writing_requirement: Report reference, shift adaptation, truth and uncertainty; describe learned markers as model features rather than causal genes.

title: DECODE: deep learning-based common deconvolution framework for various omics data
concrete_content: DECODE estimates cell types and states from tissue-level transcriptomic, proteomic and metabolomic data while aligning platforms/conditions and testing incomplete references.
decision_changed: Allow multi-omics deconvolution only with explicit reference completeness, domain-shift and known-state assumptions.
constraints: Training uses simulated tissues, artificial noise and single-cell references; reconstructed cellular layers are inferred, not measured.
skill_action: Compare against omics-specific baselines, test missing states and validate selected results with direct measurements.
writing_requirement: Methods and figures must label simulated/reference inputs and estimated outputs; Discussion must not equate multi-omics consistency with truth.

modality: bulk transcriptomics with PET pathology and clinical data
title: Integration of clinical, pathological, radiological, and transcriptomic data improves prediction for first-line immunotherapy outcome in metastatic non-small cell lung cancer
concrete_content: Baseline PET, digital pathology, bulk transcriptomics and clinical variables from 317 metastatic NSCLC patients were compared across multiple integration strategies for first-line immunotherapy outcome.
decision_changed: Require clinical, imaging and RNA unimodal baselines plus incremental multimodal value and patient-level leakage control.
constraints: One observational cohort and modality availability may induce selection; external prospective validation is still required and correlations are not immune mechanisms.
skill_action: Build the baseline ladder, fit all fusion steps in training only and report missing-modality and mapping sensitivity.
writing_requirement: Methods must define linkage/fusion/splits; Results must compare all baselines with CI/calibration; Discussion must bound mechanism.

modality: bulk RNA-seq in randomized therapy study
title: Deep molecular profiling of synovial biopsies in the STRAP trial identifies signatures predictive of treatment response to biologic therapies in rheumatoid arthritis
concrete_content: Pretreatment synovial RNA-seq from the randomized STRAP trial used repeated nested validation, external R4RA testing and translation to a 524-gene nCounter panel.
decision_changed: Demand leakage-safe development, independent cohort testing and assay translation before elevating a response signature.
constraints: Evidence is limited to rheumatoid synovium and specified biologics; sample sizes and converted-panel performance do not generalize automatically.
skill_action: Freeze the signature and panel transform, report external degradation and require a new intended-use validation for transfer.
writing_requirement: Report nested design, external cohort, panel conversion, AUC/CI and treatment context; Discussion must state disease/therapy scope.

title: A consensus blood transcriptomic framework for sepsis
concrete_content: MARS and GAinS cohorts were integrated into three consensus transcriptomic subtypes with validation across follow-up samples, a randomized trial and an external Ugandan cohort.
decision_changed: Require subtype concordance across algorithms, cohorts, time and treatment settings rather than one clustering solution.
constraints: Sepsis whole-blood subtypes are disease-, time- and composition-dependent and should not become universal or immutable patient classes.
skill_action: Quantify assignment stability, longitudinal transitions, composition and external transport; keep disease-specific scope.
writing_requirement: Methods and legends must define consensus/assignment; Results must report stability and external cohorts; Discussion must avoid fixed universal labels.

modality: tumor bulk RNA-seq with DNA-derived purity
title: Statescope: an integrative deconvolution framework for discovering cell states in tumors
concrete_content: Statescope incorporates DNA-derived malignant-cell purity and sample-varying expression to infer tumor cell states rather than only broad cell fractions.
decision_changed: For tumor-state inference require reliable purity and explicit missing-state validation.
constraints: The method is cancer-specific and a claimed state absent from the reference remains a computational discovery until confirmed.
skill_action: Audit purity, state coverage and identifiability and validate novel states with single-cell, spatial or tissue assays.
writing_requirement: Label states as inferred; report purity source and validation; avoid describing computationally discovered states as observed cells.

title: A guide to transcriptomic deconvolution in cancer
concrete_content: The review organizes 43 methods into reference-based, semi-reference-based and reference-free routes with a cancer deconvolution decision tree.
decision_changed: Choose method family from the target estimand, reference availability and validation plan before algorithm selection.
constraints: A review is not a head-to-head truth benchmark and its focus is cancer.
skill_action: Use the taxonomy to route the task, then require tissue-relevant benchmark and orthogonal truth from primary evidence.
writing_requirement: Methods must justify the selected family/reference; Discussion must not cite the review as direct validation.

title: PRECOG update: an augmented resource of clinical outcome associations with gene expression for adult, pediatric, and immunotherapy cohorts
concrete_content: PRECOG adds more than 10000 patients including pediatric and immune-checkpoint cohorts and provides gene-expression, outcome and estimated-cell associations.
decision_changed: Use large resources for hypothesis replication only after overlap, endpoint and cohort heterogeneity checks.
constraints: Most analyses are observational and heterogeneous; cross-cohort significance is not individual prediction, treatment interaction or causality.
skill_action: Create an accession/publication overlap audit and independently freeze/test any derived signature.
writing_requirement: Report source cohorts, overlap, endpoints and heterogeneity; use association rather than prediction language unless a frozen model is tested.

title: PerturbAtlas: a comprehensive atlas of public genetic perturbation bulk RNA-seq datasets
concrete_content: PerturbAtlas uniformly reanalyzes 122801 public bulk RNA-seq libraries across genetic perturbations with gene, transcript and splicing layers.
decision_changed: Use perturbation recurrence to prioritize mechanisms and replication experiments while retaining study/condition provenance.
constraints: Metadata, cell line, dose, timing and study quality are heterogeneous; cross-study consistency does not itself prove causal relevance in the target tissue.
skill_action: Trace every supporting result to original experiments and require target-context perturbation before a mechanism claim.
writing_requirement: Methods must name atlas version/query and source studies; Discussion must state context mismatch and hypothesis-generating role.

title: TIMER3: an enhanced resource for tumor immune analysis
concrete_content: TIMER3 expands cross-cancer and treatment-context immune analysis with multiple deconvolution algorithms and tumor-purity-aware associations.
decision_changed: Use multiple algorithms and cancer context for external plausibility checks, not one immune score as truth.
constraints: Algorithms may disagree and purity/cancer-type composition can drive associations; scores are not absolute cell counts or treatment-causal evidence.
skill_action: Report algorithm consensus/discordance, purity adjustment and independent tissue validation.
writing_requirement: Methods must document platform/version and algorithms; Results must show discordance; legends must say estimated immune score.

title: CTR-DB 2.0: an updated cancer clinical transcriptome resource, expanding primary drug resistance and newly adding acquired resistance datasets and enhancing the discovery and validation of predictive biomarkers
concrete_content: CTR-DB 2.0 includes 10856 patients, 39 cancer types, 346 treatment regimens and paired acquired-resistance datasets for response biomarker exploration.
decision_changed: Use therapy-aware external cohorts only after harmonizing treatment, endpoint, time and patient overlap.
constraints: Source cohorts and platforms are heterogeneous; response association in the database is not prespecified predictive interaction or clinical utility.
skill_action: Deduplicate, freeze the candidate, test an appropriate treatment comparison and report transport/failure.
writing_requirement: Methods and Results must identify source studies, therapy/endpoint definitions and independent status; Discussion must avoid untested benefit claims.

title: ASTRA: a comprehensive resource of stress-induced transcriptional activity in human cell lines
concrete_content: ASTRA standardizes human cell-line bulk RNA-seq across oxidative stress, hypoxia, heat shock and DNA damage to distinguish common and stress-specific programs.
decision_changed: Check whether an apparent disease or imaging pathway resembles a generic processing/stress response before mechanistic interpretation.
constraints: Cell lines, doses and time points do not represent patient tissue, and resource overlap is contextual evidence rather than truth.
skill_action: Use stress signatures as negative-control/sensitivity programs and verify in target tissue or perturbation.
writing_requirement: Report database/version and similarity analysis; Discussion must label stress confounding and cell-line transfer limits.

title: Analysis of gene co-expression connectivity dynamics implicates aberrant neuron-oligodendroglia interactions in schizophrenia
concrete_content: Large bulk cohorts from three brain regions were used to analyze connectivity dynamics, with single-nucleus and organoid evidence for neuron-oligodendroglia findings.
decision_changed: Require region/cohort stability and composition or cross-modal checks before interpreting a bulk co-expression module.
constraints: The observational schizophrenia-brain network is disease/tissue-specific; co-expression, cell interaction, regulation and causality are distinct.
skill_action: Test module preservation, composition sensitivity and independent/orthogonal support and use associative network wording.
writing_requirement: Methods and legends must define edges/connectivity; Results must show preservation; Discussion must not call hubs regulators without intervention.

title: Constructing gene co-functional and co-regulatory networks from public transcriptomes using condition-specific ensemble co-expression
concrete_content: Condition-specific partitioning and ensemble metrics were applied to more than 450000 public samples across 12 species to construct co-expression networks.
decision_changed: Use condition-aware ensembles and validation rather than treating one pooled public correlation matrix as universal biology.
constraints: Residual metadata/batch/composition imbalance remains and a co-expression edge is not a direct regulatory edge.
skill_action: Document public-data composition, test network stability and validate proposed regulation experimentally.
writing_requirement: Report condition selection, edge definition and validation; legends must state undirected association unless regulatory evidence exists.

title: Exon inclusion signatures enable accurate estimation of splicing factor activity
concrete_content: Perturbation-derived splicing-factor-to-exon networks were benchmarked with VIPER to estimate latent splicing-factor activity from exon-inclusion signatures.
decision_changed: Distinguish inferred functional activity from the splicing factor gene expression level.
constraints: Activity depends on transferable perturbation networks, coverage, normalization, purity and composition and is not a direct biochemical measurement.
skill_action: Report network provenance and sensitivity and validate key regulators by perturbation or functional assay.
writing_requirement: Use “inferred activity” in Results/legends; Methods must specify network and scoring; Discussion must avoid direct-activity claims.

modality: tumor bulk transcriptomics in randomized trials
title: Tumor transcriptome-wide expression classifiers predict treatment sensitivity in advanced prostate cancers
evidence_type: randomized phase III trial biomarker analysis
concrete_content: Transcriptome-wide classifiers were evaluated in 1523 randomized phase III trial patients; the Decipher analysis was prespecified, whereas the PTEN–docetaxel predictive interaction was not prespecified and requires confirmation.
decision_changed: Reserve treatment-predictive language for a valid interaction and report separately whether the classifier and interaction were prespecified.
constraints: Evidence is advanced-prostate-cancer and treatment-specific; the non-prespecified PTEN–docetaxel interaction is exploratory and subgroup findings do not automatically generalize or establish mechanism.
skill_action: Separate the prespecified Decipher analysis from exploratory PTEN results, report prognostic main effects and interaction estimates, and require a frozen new intended-use validation.
writing_requirement: Methods must state which analyses were prespecified; Results and figures must separate Decipher and PTEN evidence with arm-specific effects and interaction CI; Discussion must label the PTEN interaction exploratory.

title: T2Pdecoder enables protein-centric analyses from transcriptomic data
concrete_content: T2Pdecoder models RNA-to-protein relationships to expand predictable proteins and was principally evaluated in IDH-mutant glioma multi-omics data.
decision_changed: Permit protein-candidate prioritization from RNA only when every output is explicitly labeled predicted and compared with measured proteomics.
constraints: RNA-protein concordance is limited and validation is disease-specific; predicted protein is not a proteomic measurement.
skill_action: Require held-out cross-disease/platform testing and direct protein validation for biological or clinical claims.
writing_requirement: Methods and legends must label predicted versus measured protein; Results must report prediction error; Discussion must avoid proteomic truth wording.
